notes: From T8 to T17 the Runner spent almost every click gaining credits, holding 5 cards and building up to 25 credits, and made only one run in that stretch. On T13 it showed Sang Kancil could break the two N-Pots on Server 3 and stole Witch Hunt, but it never ran Server 3 again while Tomorrow's Headline (installed T14, scored T15) and Witch Hunt (installed T16, scored T18 for the win) were advanced there.

Sensible fast-advance plan that scored Sericulture Expansion, Project Yagi-Uda, Hybrid Release and Flower Sermon from iced remotes, and used Urtica Cipher in remotes as traps well. R&D had no ice until T5 even though the Runner ran it 4 times a turn, and money was very thin from T6 to T10, with some credit-clicking on T10.

On T2 and T3 the Runner ran the same unchanged unprotected R&D 4 times each turn, seeing the same top card again, and never drew or installed anything. This left a 3-card grip against Weyland, which won by flatline on T4 with Measured Response for 4 meat damage. On T1 it also facechecked Akhet on Server 1 with no breaker.

Scored Project Ingatan, Méliès City Luxury Line, Megaprix Qualifier and Superconducting Hub one after another behind Ansel 1.0, which the Runner could not get past, and used Seamless Launch plus the Precision Design recursion well. Credits sat at 0-2 for most of the game, and R&D had no ice until T6, so Architect Deployment Test was stolen there on T4.

The Runner won through HQ pressure with Carmen (Stoke the Embers T6, Witch Hunt T16, Post-Truth Dividend T17), but it facechecked Doomscroll on R&D on T3 with 3 credits and lost 3 cards, and played Tread Lightly into a 4-ice Server 1 on T11 with 2 credits, where Ping ended the run. It also carried tags for much of the game and spent many clicks removing them.

The Corp reached 20-33 credits and from T4 to T11 spent most clicks gaining credits, including 5 credit clicks on T5 and Petty Cash at 23 credits on T9. It built a 3-ice Server 4 on T6-T8 but never installed anything in it, and held Megaprix Qualifier x2 and Méliès City Luxury Line in an HQ protected only by Hagen until the Runner stole them. It never scored.

Running HQ and R&D through the tag-only Vasilisa every turn was workable and stole 2x Kingmaking, Remastered Edition and Artificial Cryptocrash. However, the Runner let tags pile up, so Capacitor gained the Corp 6 credits and the Corp trashed Daily Casts (T5) and Daeg (T14, T17), and its credits stayed at 0-4 from T9 on. The T9 run on Server 1 spent 6 credits on the first Capacitor and was then stopped by the second.

From T6 to T20 the Runner gained credits with every click, reaching 73 credits, and never installed a single breaker. In that stretch it made only one run (T14), so Divested Trust (T10), Above the Law (T19) and Transport Monopoly (T21) were scored from Server 1 without being contested.

On T7 the Corp played two Neurospikes that did nothing because nothing had been scored that turn, wasting 6 credits and 2 clicks and leaving it broke for the rest of the game. On T10, with the Runner at 6 points, it used Hafrún's HQ trash on Hybrid Release, and the Runner stole that from Archives for the win on T11. R&D had only Bathynomus, which let Regenesis and Lotus Haze be stolen.

The early game was good: Regenesis, Longevity Serum and Hybrid Release scored behind Knowledge Seeker by T8, and Urtica Cipher was a good trap in Server 2. After that it took 14 turns to find the last points against a passive Runner, spent all 3 clicks on a purge on T6, and gained credits on T11-T12 while already rich instead of drawing for agendas.

Solid NBN play: Embedded Reporting, Post-Truth Dividend, Next Big Thing and a second Embedded Reporting were scored from remotes behind Ping and Grubber, while Funhouse kept the Runner tagged and broke its economy. The only real slip was putting Post-Truth Dividend behind a single Funhouse on T3, where it was stolen.

After reaching 5 points on T8 the Runner played about 20 turns stuck at 0-4 credits, with Fencer Fueno and Trickster Taka draining it and Taka adding a tag every turn, which then cost 2-credit removal clicks (T13, T14, T18, T19, T21, T24, T26). It mostly ran R&D once and Archives over and over, did not attack HQ until T28, and facechecked Afshar on Server 1 with 4 credits on T5.

The Corp put agendas in Server 1 behind ice that cannot end the run (Unsmiling Tsarevna and two Virtual Service Agents), so Post-Truth Dividend was stolen on T4. On T10, with the Runner at 5 points, it installed Next Big Thing there and advanced it twice, and the Runner stole it to win. Its economy never got past about 6 credits, with endless credit clicks, and Paywall alone on HQ let Embedded Reporting go on T1.

From T7 to T15 the Runner gained credits with every click, reaching 50 credits with Tremolo installed and a full grip, and never ran again. That let Hybrid Release (T8) and both Longevity Serums (installed T13 and T15 in Server 2, scored T14 and T16) through unchallenged. Earlier, on T1-T2, it ran a tiny HQ 7 times and saw Vampyronassa again and again.

The Runner stole Project Yagi-Uda and Fujii Asset Retrieval from HQ well, but ran into an unbreakable Tatu-Bola on T2 and hit Urtica Cipher twice (T4 for 4 cards, T8 losing Tremolo). Its credits were stuck at 0-2 from T5 to T13. The winning T13 run into Saisentan with 4 credits was a desperate gamble that happened to work.

With 12-14 credits the Corp left HQ protected by a single Tithe, so Megaprix Qualifier and Architect Deployment Test were stolen on T1-T2, and it kept Hagen in hand and discarded 2 cards on T6 instead of icing up. On T7, with the Runner at 3 points, it advanced Méliès City Luxury Line twice behind only Hagen and Wave, which the Runner stole. R&D had only Vertigo, which let the last Megaprix go.

Banner got through Envelopment, and R&D pressure with Leech and Boi-tatá stole Above the Law, SDS Drone Deployment and Transport Monopoly. The economy was very thin from T2 to T8, so Fencer Fueno trashed itself, and on T6 the Runner facechecked Afshar on Server 1 with 3 credits and no code-gate breaker.

The Corp put Sericulture Expansion behind a lone Diviner on T2 (stolen) and Project Yagi-Uda behind one ice it could not afford to rez on T6 (stolen on T7). On T3 it played a Neurospike that did nothing, and it sat at 0-4 credits with Hafrún stuck in HQ. R&D had only Diviner, which let Hybrid Release and Yagi-Uda be stolen on T10.

The Corp won only because the Runner went passive after T13. Before that it put Megaprix Qualifier behind one ice on T6 (stolen with Tread Lightly), Project Ingatan behind an Eli it could not rez on T11 (stolen), and on T13 used Architect Deployment Test to put Project Ingatan in a naked new remote at 0 credits (stolen). It sat at 0-1 credits for most turns from T8 to T16, and both naked campaigns were trashed on T2-T3.

The Runner never installed a single card and from T2 to T12 spent nearly every click gaining credits, reaching 53. Apart from a T3 run into Klevetnik and a T8 Archives run it never ran, so Remastered Edition (T5), Next Big Thing (advanced T8-T10) and the second Remastered Edition (T13) were all scored from Server 2 behind one ice.
